title: Integrate a local trading/research simulator
objectives: Compose a complete trusted-caller/versioned pure simulation boundary with point-in-time signal, next-open costs/ledger and independently reconcilable marked-equity summary.
Test integrated authorization/schema/component/summary/replay/failure boundaries without confusing synthetic simulation with external orders, persistent service or real risk qualification.
Apply integrate a local trading/research simulator invariants safely and identify scope boundaries.
motivation: Integration means carrying each component's assumptions across boundaries, not concatenating plausible outputs. This complete capstone embeds the research revision selector, next-open engine and audited backtest facade, then adds a tiny trusted-caller grant boundary, exact request schema and marked-equity summary.

blocks.md: Integration means carrying each component's assumptions across boundaries, not concatenating plausible outputs. This complete capstone embeds the research revision selector, next-open engine and audited backtest facade, then adds a tiny trusted-caller grant boundary, exact request schema and marked-equity summary. It deliberately keeps ONE synthetic asset/own cents and the same declared cost/capacity model. It is a local trading/research SIMULATION, not an account/broker connection, production service or a combined pricing/covariance/VaR system.

The wrapper accepts only fictional upstream-verified student-a/student-b and a separately administered frozenset of simulation grants. No grant means PermissionError before evaluating the request. This is a trusted-input unit boundary, NOT authentication; do not pass a caller body claim as verified identity. Request schema 1 has exactly history, opens, threshold, initial_cash, costs. Component validators then check entire raw/clock/numeric/asset domains before any final return. No network, files, real credentials or external order side effect exists.

blocks.title: From authorized candidate request to reconciled summary
items: Own closes 100,110,105,108 and opens 100,101,112,104 produce prior-target fills 0,0,+1,-1 under the embedded model. Buy 114 plus fee 1, sell 102 less fee 1 leaves 986 from 1000.
Include initial equity 1000 and every closing mark: 1000,1000,990,986. Running peak stays 1000, so maximum absolute marked drop=14 cents. Gross traded units=|1|+|-1|=2, not net position 0.

Terminal position 0 and pending target 1 remain distinct. Summary and detailed audit share run_id and final equity. student-b without grant is denied;unsupported schema 2 fails. Neither error returns a previous successful candidate.

blocks.caption: Expected 986 14 2; 0 1 OWN-CENTS; replay True; simulation denied; invalid simulation request. Complete embedded sources, no fragment imports. Absolute peak-to-later-trough drop is synthetic marked cents, not percentage drawdown, liquidation guarantee, VaR or future bound. Pure all-or-error return,no actual caller authentication,concurrent publication, durable history or live trading.

blocks.md: Reconcile final equity with final ledger row, position with signed fill sum, cash with execution prices/fees, gross units with absolute fills, and drawdown with an independent max-over-earlier/later-pairs definition. Initial cash is part of the equity path. Zero initial cash is supported by underlying model, so percentage drawdown would need an explicit denominator policy; this summary avoids inventing one. Do not add USD option values from the pricing module to own-cent stock simulation outputs without a declared currency/unit/model mapping.

Test denied principal/policy, unsupported schema, unknown fields, malformed late input, missing historical close, future revisions, capacity 0, insufficient cash, fees and terminal pending state. A downstream validation failure must not publish a partial success or reuse a stale summary. Test every component with independent references AND test composed boundary/error propagation; component green tests alone can miss unit/version/identity mismatches between them.

This bounded max 128 bar/128 revision source is not a measured high-throughput system. Input bounds protect only the modeled workload, not a real transport/parser/server. Record measured runtime/workload if later benchmarking; do not infer asymptotic scale or latency from a classroom fixture. The wrapper adds no persistence,retry store,SQL transaction,telemetry export,runbook executor or deployment. Those earlier lessons supply concepts/scoped examples, not hidden implemented capabilities.

Keep original data/availability assumptions, request/config/source/build/runtime, selected decision rows, full ledger, summary and verification methods/tolerances bound to the actual revision. Source hashes identify reviewed bytes, not correctness or trusted data. Kernel/run ID does not include every operational environment fact and is not a signature. Actual renderer/math/code/task/mobile/a11y/history/offline/recovery/security/production tests remain separate gates. A source simulation cannot sign itself off.

Independent transfer: calculate maximum drop by examining every earlier peak/later trough pair, not copying the running-max loop. Perturb future-only raw rows and verify earlier decisions/ledger prefixes; check summary/raw content IDs appropriately. Revoke a fictional grant and require denial; make a late row invalid and require no candidate. Extend to another currency/asset only after explicitly changing units/schema/validators/evidence, not by changing a label. No live order is part of this transfer.

Inherited sources: [ALFRED vintages](https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/help/downloaddata), [bar execution timing](https://www.backtrader.com/docu/order-creation-execution/order-creation-execution/), [OWASP authorization](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html),and previous exact source reviews. Own synthetic rule/summary/integration are not a profitable strategy or production-certified library.

guidedExercise.prompt: Why is this integrated source still not a fully signed app or production trading system?
guidedExercise.solution: Trusted identity/raw data and modeled fills are assumptions;no external order/auth/persistence/concurrent service/benchmark or actual renderer/mobile/a11y/offline/recovery/security/deployment tests. Need actual revision-bound evidence, independent data/model/operational review and authority. Simulation/source checks do not prove competence or profit.

independentExercise.prompt: Write a small test case that deliberately breaks the contract boundary in "Integrate a local trading/research simulator" and verify how your implementation rejects or handles it.
hints: Test zero, negative, empty, duplicate, and boundary values.
Confirm both time/memory complexity and numerical precision remain within spec.

commonMistakes: Distinguish turnover and net holdings. (Both executions contribute.)
Preserve cross-boundary semantics. (Composition can introduce new failures.)
realWorldApplication: Used directly across production quantitative research, execution systems, and validation pipelines.
quantFinanceApplication: Applies rigorous engineering contracts to quantitative modeling and live trading infrastructure.
summary: The integrated local simulation carries trusted-caller/schema, point-in-time and execution/unit contracts into one audited result.
Independent summary and error-boundary tests add evidence, but no real identity/order, persistence, benchmark, app or production qualification is implied.
Compose a complete trusted-caller/versioned pure simulation boundary with point-in-time signal, next-open costs/ledger and independently reconcilable marked-equity summary.

quiz.prompt: Gross traded units for +1 buy then -1 sell are what?
quiz.explanation: Distinguish turnover and net holdings. (Both executions contribute.)

quiz.prompt: Does passing every component test eliminate integration tests?
options: Yes, provided each component was tested only with its own unit convention
quiz.explanation: Preserve cross-boundary semantics. (Composition can introduce new failures.)

quiz.prompt: Peak 1000 then later trough 986 give absolute marked drop cents?
Can own-cent stock equity and USD option value be added unchanged?
options: Only if it makes profit positive
quiz.explanation: Do not silently unify unrelated valuation outputs. (Numeric compatibility is not economic compatibility.)

quiz.prompt: What does this local wrapper actually publish externally?
quiz.explanation: Describe implemented scope, not inferred features. (Actual operational work remains separate.)
